acceptanceCriteria: Sites (1)-(3) report the distinct timeout code/class introduced by MCPV0-038 and GLTP-V0-054, each with a test and one mutation, or the governing spec records why the site keeps the old mapping.
Item (4) is answered in a build-log entry (intended fail-closed currency, or fixed).
body: Residual from the V1-1427/1428/1429 lane (PR #933, head ebc2525ad, BASE 53e7e3df2; darwin go1.27.2). PR #933 gave the MCP bridge a distinct repository-probe-timeout code (MCPV0-038) and post-run authority deadlines an ErrAuthorityUnavailable class (GLTP-V0-054), but four sites keep the old mapping: (1) internal/mcp/docsbridge/docsbridge.go:268 maps a probe timeout to repository-unavailable; (2) the bridge CEM code map maps cemcode.GitTimeout to repository-unavailable; (3) the early-exit release at cmd/corvint-go-test-provider (provider.go:322) still reports a timeout as drift; (4) question: a failed post-run observe still yields STALE/UNKNOWN currency, which may be the intended fail-closed outcome. Expected: a timeout is reported as a timeout everywhere the governing spec distinguishes it. Actual: sites (1)-(3) report unavailable/drift.
title: Remaining timeout sites still report repository-unavailable or authority drift after V1-1427/1428
